body.message:
We would like to clarify that, unlike hotels, our holiday homes at fäm Living are located in cozy residential buildings managed by individual landlords. This means you can enjoy the comfort and privacy of a fully furnished home rather than a traditional hotel room.


Our rates include utilities, VAT, DTCM fees, and other applicable charges.

However, additional cleaning during your stay is not included. If you require extra cleaning, we will be happy to arrange it for you at an additional charge per cleaning service.


Thank you for your understanding.
